source_boundary: Active uploaded and repository evidence only; externally retrieved cohort metrics excluded.

axis_1.name: Frontline Substrate Loading (Cytidine Analogs)
axis_1.mechanism: Unrepaired BER substrate accumulation stalls active replication forks

axis_2.name: Replication Stress Checkpoint Cascade
axis_2.mechanism: MBD4-associated lesion stalling creates reliance on ATR/CHK1/WEE1 fork stabilization

axis_3.name: Hypermutator Phenotype & Immune Checkpoint Blockade
axis_3.mechanism: Spontaneous CpG deamination failure fixing CpG>TpG transition mutations, driving a hypermutator phenotype

evidence.clinical_outcomes: Associated with exceptional anti-PD-1 response in a sentinel case and improved clinical outcomes within a five-patient MBD4-mutated uveal melanoma subgroup.
evidence.validation_boundary: Neoantigen load and CD8-recruitment pathways represent biological interpretations requiring prospective assay validation.
